name: BACH_0258_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (52%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
The 90% conformal set spans InSitu (52%) and Benign (42%) on a stain-degraded simulated frozen section [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 52%, Benign 42%, Normal 4%, Invasive 2% | InSitu leads, Benign close behind |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage target) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, OOD percentile 1.0 (12/12 tiles) [F6] | Passes QC despite stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True | Independent models share top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (79%–83% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors all match InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 7, 10) · context · Above-typical score (1.37); -0.75 contribution away from invasive [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Typical score (0.30, z -0.35) yields +0.21 contribution [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (1.09, +0.16 contribution); 0/20 spot checks [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (1.19, +0.16 contribution); 3/20 spot checks · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-average score (0.31, z -0.30) reduces invasive score (-0.13) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (mean +0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation on this simulated frozen section masks benign mimicry (42% Benign; Normal contrast case 76% similar).
- Deeper levels reveal unsampled lesion, or elevated margin segments (inferior 97%, superior 87%, medial 83%) involve margins [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 4**: Highest heatmap risk (27%, 6%); verify whether true atypia or stain artifact drives signal.
2. **Regions 1, 7, 10**: Assess ductal architecture and TILs to separate InSitu from Benign; consider drafted deeper levels.
3. **Regions 9, 3, 0**: Inspect inferior (97%), superior (87%), and medial (83%) margin hotspots despite clear call.
